besluite.fout: The relative clause 'wat 'n paar mense vervoer' follows 'enjin' directly, so it can be read as the engine carrying the people.
besluite.rede: The fault is real, but this study sentence is word for word the 'motor' glossary definition, so changing only the sentence would make the two differ; the writer must fix both together.

besluite.fout: 'Die meeste motors se enjin' in the singular reads as if many cars share one engine.
besluite.rede: The plural is the natural Afrikaans after a plural possessor, same word count, meaning unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'wag vir die trein se eie tyd' is wooden; 'eie tyd' is not a natural way to say timetable.
besluite.rede: 'by die trein se tye hou' is the idiomatic way to say people had to fit the train's timetable, which still contrasts with the driver deciding for himself, and it is one word shorter.

besluite.fout: Missing comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have a subject and verb ('Hulle was', 'min mense het').
besluite.rede: AWS 2017 requires the comma here; no words added.
Placing 'vir gewone gesinne' after the participle is normal Afrikaans and reads easily, so moving it is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: 'waar' as a contrastive conjunction is stiff and a Grade 4 reader takes it as a place.
besluite.rede: 'terwyl' carries the same contrastive sense plainly, same word count, meaning unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'gereedskap wat die enjin kon regmaak' can attach the relative clause to the tools instead of the person.
besluite.rede: The reorder ties the clause to 'Iemand' with the same words, and dropping the comma is correct because the joined part has no main clause of its own.

besluite.fout: 'sy skoene' can be read as the person's own shoes, and 'skoene' for a horse is loose; the Afrikaans word is 'hoefysters'.
besluite.rede: The proposal keeps the horse and the person, removes the pronoun ambiguity, uses the correct word and is one word shorter.

besluite.fout: The present-tense 'jaag' in the relative clause clashes with the past 'was dit' of the main clause.
besluite.rede: Tense agreement is a real grammar fault, which justifies the one added word at the ceiling.

besluite.fout: 'dit hang af waar' leaves out the required 'daarvan' before a following clause.
besluite.rede: Standard written Afrikaans needs 'hang daarvan af waar'; a real fault that justifies one added word, meaning unchanged.
